subject: AWS seller path / co-sell handoff — CloudBridge marketplace intake
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia@cloudbridge.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + request: AWS co-sell / marketplace listing for CloudBridge

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for taking a look. We talked briefly at the Summit — CloudBridge is ready to start AWS co-sell registration and get our listing into the marketplace. Quick background: we provide a vector search SaaS optimized for retrieval-augmented generation; pilot with a large healthcare customer is live and we expect a commercial opportunity next quarter.

Two asks to start:
- Can Redwood help with ACE registration and PDM/PSM intros so we can map co-sell coverage?
- What information do you need from us (security artifacts, brief, logos, expected ARR timeline)?

Attached a short opportunity summary and SOC2 excerpts. Happy to run a 30-min sync. Are you available this week?

Best,
Alicia Gomez
Head of Partnerships, CloudBridge
attachments: CloudBridge-ACE-Opportunity-Summary.pdf, CloudBridge-SOC2-Excerpts.zip

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@cloudbridge.io>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-10-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + request: AWS co-sell / marketplace listing for CloudBridge

Alicia — great to meet you at the Summit and thanks for the materials. Looping in Kimberly (PDM) and Ben (PSM) to handle ACE intake and marketplace readiness.

Kimberly & Ben — CloudBridge is looking to initiate AWS co-sell registration and marketplace listing. Key facts: vector search SaaS, active pilot in healthcare (large prospect), expects ARR conversion in Q1 next year. Attached are their summary + SOC2 excerpts (see Alicia's email).

Can we do a 30-min intake tomorrow? If helpful, Alicia, you can share your preferred times and we’ll send a calendar invite.

Action items:
- Kimberly: review ACE intake requirements and confirm any pre-reqs on our side
- Ben: prepare a draft mutual action plan outline and list of marketplace assets required

Thanks — I’ll own coordination.

— Marcus

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Alicia Gomez <alicia@cloudbridge.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-10-02T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + request: AWS co-sell / marketplace listing for CloudBridge

Thanks Marcus and Alicia — quick checklist from the PDM side to help scope the intake:

Required for ACE intake and marketplace listing (initial):
- Company legal name + AWS account IDs (for co-sell registration)
- High-level value proposition + top customer logos (1–3) for the listing blurb
- Security artifacts: SOC2 Type II report (or excerpts), Data processing addendum (if available), encryption/KMS approach
- Estimated ARR/forecast for next 12 months (range is fine) and target regions (us/eu/apac)
- Preferred PSM contact for post-listing enablement

Optional but helpful: demo tenant access or a 10-min product video; one-pager for marketplace listing copy.

If CloudBridge can share the items above, I’ll confirm ACE readiness and feed any open asks back to the team. Also propose 10/02 3pm PT for the intake — Ben, Marcus, does that work?

— Kimberly
Product Director, Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@cloudbridge.io>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-10-02T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + request: AWS co-sell / marketplace listing for CloudBridge

Alicia — great materials. 3pm PT tomorrow works for me. I’ll own the mutual action plan (MAP) and go-to-market checklist. For the MAP draft I’ll include:
- Milestones: ACE registration, marketplace listing, co-sell enablement, joint demo schedule, opportunity qualification criteria
- Responsible parties and expected lead times (we'll use 2-week sprints for initial tasks)
- Required artifacts from CloudBridge (P1: SOC2, logos, partner profile; P2: demo access, product one-pager)

I attached a short MAP template to this thread and a marketplace asset checklist — placeholder filenames below. We can fill in during the call.

attachments: Redwood-MAP-Template.xlsx, Marketplace-Assets-Checklist.md

See you tomorrow.

— Ben

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia@cloudbridge.io>

Date: 2028-10-03T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + request: AWS co-sell / marketplace listing for CloudBridge
